arguments.title: Historical planning card — conditional small-business activation target (2023)
arguments.body:
## Conditional target

**Target:** 65% activation for the small-business tier.

**Applies only if:** the sub-50-seat tier actually ships in Q3. Until that event, the existing Q1 activation target of 60% remains unchanged into Q2.

**Historical note:** Recorded April 5, 2023; this is a conditional planning target, not evidence that the tier shipped or that the target took effect.
